# Travel and Expense Policy v6 (Superseded)

**Policy code:** FIN-EXP-06
**Effective:** 15 January 2024
**Retired:** 31 March 2026 — superseded by Travel and Expense Policy v7 (FIN-EXP-07)
**Owner:** Dolores Achterberg, Controller
**Classification:** Internal — Finance

> **This document is retained for audit purposes only. Do not apply these rates
> to travel undertaken on or after 1 April 2026.**

## 1. Per diem allowances

| Travel type | Allowance |
| --- | --- |
| Domestic (same country as home office) | **$58 per day** |
| International | **$84 per day** |
| Same-day travel under 6 hours | Not eligible |

## 2. Pre-approval threshold

Any single expense item **above $1,800** requires written pre-approval from a
cost-centre owner.

## 3. Receipt submission window

Receipts must be submitted within **30 calendar days** of the transaction date.

## 4. Mileage

Personal vehicle mileage is reimbursed at **$0.52 per mile**.

## 5. Non-reimbursable items

- In-flight wifi above $25 per segment
- Hotel minibar
- Traffic and parking fines
- Personal travel insurance
